name: kernel-arch-rv64
description: RISC-V 64 implementation of witos/arch.h and witos/virtual.h (plan steps V1.2 and V1.3): identity, guarded boot stack, the interrupt flag and halting, the trap vector with full register frames, the timer-interrupt scheduler hook, Sv48 kernel translation tables, U-mode thread frames, contexts and entry, user translation tables, code publication, the SBI call, the boot hart's identity and the compiler helpers; the secondary harts (V1.4) panic by name.
